events.name: Rev. William J. Laws, D.D., son of John and Anna Laws of Bethel
events.description: "Laws, William Joseph, son of John and Anna Laws, both members of Bethel A. M. E., Philadelphia, was born in Frederica, Delaware, one of four children. He entered school in 1859, receiving his education in the public schools and Lincoln University..." Converted 1864; licensed to preach 1868 at Oxford, Pa.; joined the annual Conference 1871 at Boston; ordained deacon 1871 and elder 1872; pastorates from New England to Iowa, Illinois, Minnesota and Texas; president of Paul Quinn College for five years. Source: Richard R. Wright Jr., ed., Centennial Encyclopaedia of the African Methodist Episcopal Church (Philadelphia, 1916), p. 147 (with his portrait, 'Rev. Wm. J. Laws, D.D.'). His father, John Laws, is named in the text only.
